answer: One fake identity costs one real job: $600 monthly in wages plus payroll tax, and one job cannot be split across fifty identities because one payroll record names one worker. The applicant links a payroll account that the network queries directly. It confirms an active worker and a cleared first paycheck. Enrollment asks for a one-time phrase from the live portal, quartz spiral dawn, visible only when signed into that account. The check repeats every 90 days, and a lost job freezes the identity within a week. A farm trying this is like staffing a thousand desks with one employee.
